research:
I'm leaving out every figure dated after 2026-10-02 that showed up in the search results.

## 1. Resolution source
- The source is the AAA national average for regular gasoline at gasprices.aaa.com. I could not load the page directly because the proxy refused the connection every time. [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/)
- 2026-10-01: AAA's weekly release put the national average at **$4.41**, down nearly 7 cents from the week before. AAA said crude oil falling back into the $90s per barrel drove the dip. A search snippet shows the daily figure on that page as $4.4137. [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/national-average-dips-following-record-setting-september/)
- 2026-10-02: A third-party report citing AAA and DOE data gave about **$4.40** for that day. I could not confirm an exact AAA daily print for October 2. [finder.com](https://www.finder.com/economics/gas-prices)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. On about October 2 the average was roughly $4.40, about 2 cents above the $4.38 threshold. To fall below $4.38 by October 5, it would need to drop a bit more than 2 cents in 3 days. The recent pace has been about 1 cent per day. It is close.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-02: New York's average was $4.48 while national prices eased after a record September. [FingerLakes1](https://www.fingerlakes1.com/2026/10/02/new-york-gas-averages-4-48-as-national-prices-ease-after-record-september/)
- 2026-10-01: AAA reported the national average at $4.41, down about 7 cents in a week. WTI rose $1.04 to settle at $90.42 on Wednesday, September 30. September 2026 set the record for a September average: about $4.33 by one AAA-based report, beating the previous record of $3.83 set in 2023. [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/national-average-dips-following-record-setting-september/)
- 2026-09-30: Brent was reported at $103.53, up from $72.92 at the end of June. [DataPorium](https://dataporium.tech/articles/gas-prices-september-2026-highest-september-on-record)
- About 2026-09-24: AAA put the average at about $4.48, the highest on record for that time of year. It blamed instability in the Strait of Hormuz and expensive crude. [AAA newsroom](https://newsroom.aaa.com/2026/09/national-average-climbs-nearly-5-cents-since-last-week/)
- Background: the Iran conflict began on 2026-02-28, when gas averaged about $2.98. [Coinpaper](https://coinpaper.com/37891/gas-prices-today-trump-calls-4-29-gas-a-small-price-to-pay-for-iran-war-as-oil-stays-above-100)

## 4. Base rates and trend
- Recent AAA levels: about $4.48 (around September 24), $4.41 (October 1), about $4.40 (October 2). That is a fall of about 7 to 8 cents in a week, or roughly 1 cent per day. [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/national-average-dips-following-record-setting-september/)
- EIA monthly averages for regular gasoline: July $3.93, August $4.06, September $4.36. [LendingTree](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/study/us-gas-prices/)
- Seasonal pattern: early October usually brings declines as stations switch to cheaper winter-blend fuel. The national average typically moves about 0 to 4 cents over 3 days in normal conditions. During this conflict, weekly swings of 5 to 7 cents have been common.
- The 2026 high so far is $4.564, set on 2026-05-21. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/prediction-markets/how-high-will-gas-prices-get-kalshi-odds)
- Simple straight-line math: at about 1 cent per day from $4.40, October 5 would land near $4.37 to $4.38, right at the threshold. A rise in wholesale prices, such as WTI's increase on September 30, could slow the decline.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi runs AAA gas-price markets (KXAAAGASM for monthly, KXAAAGASW for weekly). I could not get reliable odds dated before the cutoff for October 5 specifically. The snapshot I found was for the month-end contract and was undated, so I did not use it. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxaaagasm/us-gas-price/kxaaagasm-26oct31)
- Manifold has a sibling question asking whether the average will be $4.42 or more on October 5. I did not find its current probability. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Jack1/us-average-gas-price-is-44200-or-mo)
- GasBuddy's January 2026 outlook, which predicted about $2.97 for the year, came before the war and is no longer relevant. [Houston Chronicle](https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/houston-texas/trending/article/gasbuddy-2026-gas-prices-forecast-21278999.php)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Crude oil trading on October 2 and the weekend: news about the Strait of Hormuz or the Iran conflict could reverse the decline. WTI was around $90 on September 30.
- Gasoline futures (RBOB) on October 2: wholesale moves reach pump prices with a lag of a few days.
- AAA's daily updates on October 3, 4 and 5. The question resolves on the October 5 print, around 07:41 UTC.
- The ongoing switch to winter-blend fuel should keep pushing prices down.
